about: Each season's World Football Elo on 1 July of its end year, computed from martj42's results (CC0) by the formula eloratings.net publishes: every team that played in the four years before, [results name, Elo, rank, confederation]; its confederation levels (scripts/lib/confederation-levels.mjs: [confederation, level, standard error, matches]) and the best levelled Elo.
